issue.title: test_typing_space_inside_parens_shows_tail_ghost flakes under the parallel lane

task_type_fields.evidence: Fail then pass on an unchanged tree. sase tool run check 3acd4d900f214c6830bc663849aed9dd (pytest -n 7, host load about 15-24) failed this node: AssertionError assert '[^T] word' not in '[^T] word ...58,169,159)]'. The next serial run on that same tree (a10a6c6035 plus the uncommitted scope-sweep privatization, which does not import this test) passed. A later serial run on 092fd1db05 also passed. The test file is not in the eight commits between those SHAs. Observed fail rate 1 of 3, and the only failure was the parallel lane. Not caused by sase-1i4.

issue.creation_reason: The scoped check failed this prompt-bar test once under parallel load, and the same tree passed it on the next serial run. It is intermittent and not caused by the agent-scope epic.

payload.description: Parallel-lane flake seen during sase-1i4 landing; serial rerun passed

evidence.note: Independent CI reproduction (sase-1io.land, 2026-10-09): Full CI run 37909515949 at e2efd56242, job 'full / test (3.13)' (GitHub-hosted runner, sharded fast suite) failed this node with the same AssertionError: assert '[^T] word' not in '[^T] word  [^L] all ... Col 15'. The 3.14 leg of the same run passed it. Impact: it is one of the reds keeping Full CI from the green run the sase 0.18.0 release (epic sase-1io) needs.

payload.entry: Supplementary evidence from phase sase-1io.7.3 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, triaged by land agent sase-1io.7.land): the Full CI 3.13 failure it cites is run 37909515949, which sase-1io.land already +1'd here, so this is not a new reporter. New data: sase-1io.7.3 tried 6 local reruns on the tip (serial, -n7, and 5x -n4) and all passed, so there is still no local repro. Treat this as a CI-runner-only parallel-lane race.

evidence.note: Independent local reproduction relayed from phase sase-1io.7.6.1 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1 (2026-10-09): tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_next_word_inline_tail.py::test_typing_space_inside_parens_shows_tail_ghost failed once in the full just check parallel lane (1 failed, 54363 passed) and passed in isolation on both the patched tree and a clean base. Same parallel-lane flake; the phase diff did not touch this test. This is not Full CI run 37909515949, which is already recorded.
